The original text of the 《Bencao Jing》: 蜀椒 (shǔjiāo), flavor acrid, warm. It governs evil-qi cough and retching, warms the center, expels dead flesh of the bones, joints, and skin, cold-damp bi pain (寒濕痹痛), and descends qi (下氣). Taken for a long time, the head does not turn white...
